CustomField.description: Lead UI pilot: due state of a Re-Nurture follow-up from Reengagement_Date_CC__c, for the Re-Nurture follow-up list views. Display only: reaching the date never changes Status.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Re-Nurture"), IF( ISBLANK(Reengagement_Date_CC__c), "No date set", IF( Reengagement_Date_CC__c < TODAY(), "Overdue", IF(Reengagement_Date_CC__c = TODAY(), "Due today", "Upcoming") ) ), NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: For Re-Nurture Leads: Overdue, Due today, Upcoming or No date set, from the Re-engagement Date. Status never changes on the date by itself.
CustomField.label: Re-Nurture Follow-up
